name: Rassvet over Ukraine
start:
set -u
LOG="${HOME}/.cursor/pstack-setup.log"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "${LOG}")"
log() {
  local line
  line="$(printf '%s %s' "$(date -Is)" "$*")"
  printf '%s\n' "${line}" >> "${LOG}"
  printf '%s\n' "${line}"
}
deadline="${PSTACK_CHECKOUT_WAIT_SECONDS:-60}"
case "${deadline}" in
  ''|*[!0-9]*) deadline=60 ;;
esac
log "pstack setup: start hook waiting up to ${deadline}s for checkout"
i=0
while [[ ! -s .cursor/setup-cloud-agent.sh || ! -s .cursor/pstack/pstack-models.mdc ]]; do
  i=$((i + 1))
  if [[ "${i}" -ge "${deadline}" ]]; then
    log "pstack setup: timed out after ${deadline}s waiting for .cursor/setup-cloud-agent.sh and .cursor/pstack/pstack-models.mdc"
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 1
done
log "pstack setup: workspace files present after ${i}s; running setup"
exec bash .cursor/setup-cloud-agent.sh
